inspections.title: CPR / life support not provided properly
inspections.detail: Provide basic life support, including CPR, prior to the arrival of emergency medical personnel , subject to physician orders and the resident’s advance directives.

inspections.title: Nurse aides missing required dementia and abuse training
inspections.detail: Ensure nurse aides have the skills they need to care for residents, and give nurse aides education in dementia care and abuse prevention.

inspections.title: Unclean or uncomfortable living space
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.

inspections.title: Poor ventilation
inspections.detail: Have enough outside ventilation via a window or mechanical ventilation, or both.

inspections.title: Resident dignity not respected
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.

inspections.title: Transfer / bed-hold notice not given
inspections.detail: Provide the required documentation or notification related to the resident's needs, appeal rights, or bed-hold policies.

inspections.title: Resident lost abilities without medical reason
inspections.detail: Ensure residents do not lose the ability to perform activities of daily living unless there is a medical reason.
